title: Daily rehearsals on the road
summary: The band rehearsed nearly every day, with no lateness or grumbling.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: Dink, we actually rehearsed most every day.

We were traveling. We would get into a town early and maybe rest a little while and I would call a rehearsal. And then, of course, the guys would tell me, say, old man, call a rehearsal. We got a new arrangement to be back together. Well, no problem. Nobody late. Nobody grouchy.
Come and rehearse. And sit down and do what you had to do and leave.
